cards.prompt: Why do you need more coffee after a year of drinking it daily than on day one?
cards.answer: Tolerance: the brain produces more adenosine receptors as caffeine intake increases.

cards.prompt: As caffeine consumption rises, the brain builds more ____ receptors, which raises tolerance.
Needing three coffees a day after a year, when one used to be enough, is a sign of tolerance building up.
cards.answer: Fact: the brain makes more receptors as caffeine intake increases, so tolerance grows.

cards.prompt: Your friend says one coffee gave him energy last year but now barely works. What process explains this?
cards.answer: Tolerance: with regular caffeine intake his brain has produced more adenosine receptors, so the same dose has less effect.
